name: Ecem Öztürk
bio: Ecem [pronounced A-Gem] is a designer and art director based in Toronto. Her practice moves between brand identity, editorial direction and immersive 3D. She holds a BA in Design, concentrating in Interior Design & an MDes in Digital Futures. Her interests circle tactility, objects and memory in a tech-infused world.
